runner: run_simpler_env.py: the loop of SimplerEnv's run_maniskill2_eval_single_episode over the official episode list
note: Octo-Base 1.0 (octo commit 653c54a as in SimplerEnv's README), SimplerEnv's own OctoInference with --octo-init-rng 0 defaults; jax 0.4.20 on the CPU (no RTX 5090 kernels), rendering on the GPU. One rng stream per worker, so episode noise depends on the worker split.
